title: Complete Dynamics GP Migration to Business Central

facts.text: Validate migrated data by running migration validation tests from Cloud Migration Management page.
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Disable Cloud Migration with SUPER permission set.
On Cloud Ready Checklist page, turn on I have read and understand the recommended steps switch, then select Disable Cloud Migration.
Integration runtime remains installed after disabling cloud migration and can be reused for future migrations.
Set up users by creating Microsoft 365 accounts with Business Central licenses for each user.
Create Business Central accounts associated with Microsoft 365 email and assign proper permissions to data.
Dynamics GP user accounts and permissions are not migrated to Business Central online.
